packageRules.description: The anacrolix modules break each other across minor versions (anacrolix/stm v0.6.0 removed Settish.Iter, which anacrolix/dht still used). Update them together and review by hand.
pion modules (WebRTC, behind anacrolix's WebTorrent support) only build when they move together.
openapi-typescript 7.13 needs TypeScript 5's compiler API (openapi-ts/openapi-typescript#2841), so the generator package stays on TypeScript 5.

website/pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides pin patched releases of build-time dependencies that Blume's dependencies hold back; a newer major would break them. Drop each override once its dependent updates.
